areas.title: Editor and Files

areas.title: Browser

areas.title: Worktrees and repositories

areas.note: Configuration and setup surfaces only; no real orchestration, handoff, loop or provider agent is started.

areas.title: Ledger
areas.note: The actual Ledger view with local fixture state; no real project ledger is edited.

areas.title: Ask, notifications and Structured sessions

areas.title: Settings, Mobile, CLI, palette and workspace extras
areas.note: Desktop contribution of Mobile only; the phone app is unchanged and pairing remains off. Sidebar extras owns the Sidebar section separators checkbox visible in Settings; its legacy Source Control activity registration is projected into Changes (shown above), and current Activity filters are shown with Worktrees. No separate legacy mount is invented.

contributionAliases.repo: Repository rows in the Worktrees contribution; no standalone pane invented.
contributionAliases.sidebarExtras: Sidebar section separators in host Settings; legacy Source Control activity is projected into Changes.

limits: Representative surfaces for every rollout area, not every dialog, data state or interaction.
Historical/current fixtures and selected tabs differ; not pixel-diff baselines.
Some screenshots retain incidental background metadata loading; intended-area Tasks skeleton candidates and unproved GPU-auto terminal candidates were excluded.
Terminal capture uses public gpu-acceleration=off in disposable homes; actual PTY marker is visible.
Before supplemental captures may retain the isolated Accounts Configure usage tracking card. Keychain unavailable is the fail-closed fixture security state.
Local-only repository has no origin: hosted-review lookup is unavailable by construction. Tasks uses Projects with no selected remote project.
Browser is a genuine managed Watch/JPEG stream of matching unstyled loopback /review HTML, not native WKWebView.
Loop setup shows unavailable agents; no loop or provider agent was launched.
No personal provider account, history, login or runtime credential is included.
No OS chrome, native notifications, phone app, provider approval-turn, full behavior suite or independent golden score is certified.
